correctness.rationale: Two affine half slopes P=2(1+b)>1 and Q=2(1-b)>=0 force every regular attracting least-two orbit to have one point in each half: same expanding branch cannot attract, same contracting branch cannot interchange two separated points for b>=1/2, and for b<1/2 its multiplier exceeds one. Mixed multiplier PQ=4(1-b²)<1 iff b>sqrt(3)/2. Integer lift difference is 1 or 2 and inverse affine parametrization by y∈(1/2,1) gives exactly two disjoint intervals, width (4b²-3)/(2(3+2b)). Integration gives area -11/4+3sqrt(3)/2+3log(5/(3+sqrt(3))); at PQ=1 two shifts make return identity on open intervals. Independently tested 18 rational orbit identities and symbolic width/integral; finite tests do not prove all b.
